segments.label: PAPER
segments.headline: Why can't AI plug in a cable?

beats.narration: Plugging in a cable is easy for us, but it takes a precise touch, and that is hard for robots.
So what happened when one of today's most advanced AI models took control of a real robot and tried it?
Researchers gave the AI direct control of real robot arms and asked it to do everyday tasks.
Picking things up and putting them somewhere else mostly worked.

visual.text: Pick up, put down: mostly worked

beats.narration: But plugging in the cable failed every single time.
The researchers' verdict: these AI models are competent, but not yet practical for real robots.

visual.sub: The researchers' verdict · early paper, small tests

beats.narration: Their report says precise, hands-on tasks like this are still much harder.
How researchers are trying to close that gap is in this week's full episode. Link below.
